scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0080; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Character prompts and English distractors were re-read as complete learner-facing utterances; teacher directives and known ungrammatical generated distractors were removed.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: نشان دادن is preserved directly across both learner turns.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Wrong English options are grammatical/natural alternatives that differ on meaning, action, referent, quantity, polarity or context instead of using broken substitutions.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: The imperative frame is short and controlled for A1 practice.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner transfers show from photo to map.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, target, activities and retrieval all align.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
